note: Realistic filled-in states in the fit-note grader's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `gradeFitNote` is a single self-contained engine (no separate flags module, no timestamp): validity, adaptation, period, and safety rule sets fire independently, then `recommendation` is decided top-down with validity superseding everything. Verified nuances: `safetyFlags` are returned in push order, NOT sorted by priority (unlike every other engine in this backlog); the automatic-disability rule fires on a regex over the free-text diagnosis (HIV / cancer / carcinoma / malignan- / neoplasm / multiple sclerosis) even when the explicit yes/no field is blank; and `periodCompliance` 'exceeds_initial_max' needs both > 90 days AND the condition first recorded within the last 183 days of the assessment, else the same period is only 'long_term'.

personas.name: standard-may-be-fit-compliant-period
personas.description: A valid GP-issued note for a lower-back strain: 'may be fit' with two adaptations (phased return, altered hours) and practical comments, a 3-week duration in the first month of the condition — the adaptation rule fires at 'moderate' intensity (count 2, low severity) and the period is 'compliant' (21 days) — expect isValid yes, fitnessCategory may_be_fit, adaptationIntensity moderate, periodDays 21, periodCompliance compliant, isWithinFirstSixMonthsOfCondition yes, recommendation standard, and no safety flags.

state.comments: Avoid lifting over 10 kg for three weeks; shorter shifts initially, building back to full hours.

personas.name: refer-occupational-health-long-term-not-fit-nurse-issued
personas.description: A nurse-issued (2022-authorised profession) note for a moderate depressive episode: 'not fit' (so no adaptation rules at all), a from/to period of 49 days — over 4 weeks but under 3 months, so 'long_term' rather than 'exceeds_initial_max' even though the condition is within its first six months — with a review booked; the mental-health, new-authority, and review safety rules also fire — expect isValid yes, fitnessCategory not_fit, adaptationIntensity blank, periodDays 49, periodCompliance long_term, recommendation refer_occupational_health, and four safety flags in push order (4-week, mental-health, new-authority, review).

firedRules.description: Review at end of period requested.

safetyFlags.description: Mental-health diagnosis — additional support pathways available.
safetyFlags.suggestedAction: Signpost to NHS Talking Therapies, MIND, or workplace mental-health resources.

safetyFlags.description: Clinician will reassess at end of period.

personas.name: review-for-validity-supersedes-cancer-and-over-max-period
personas.description: A hospital-discharge note for a patient recovering from breast cancer surgery with the practice address left blank: the missing address is a high-severity validity failure, so the recommendation is review_for_validity even though this note would otherwise be refer_access_to_work (the diagnosis text matches the automatic-disability regex although the explicit yes/no field is blank) and also breaches the 3-months-in-first-6-months rule (4 months = 122 days, condition recorded 60 days earlier) — expect isValid no, periodDays 122, periodCompliance exceeds_initial_max, isWithinFirstSixMonthsOfCondition yes, recommendation review_for_validity, and seven safety flags in push order (validity, period-max, 4-week, 12-week, auto-disability, discharge, review with the 'end of the period' fallback text).
